name: ed-journal-monitor-decky
description: Decky plugin that monitors Elite Dangerous journal files and submits events to EDDN

scripts.package: npm run build && rm -rf out && mkdir -p out/ed-journal-monitor/dist out/ed-journal-monitor/bin/src && cp plugin.json main.py package.json LICENSE README.md out/ed-journal-monitor/ && cp dist/index.js out/ed-journal-monitor/dist/ && cp -r src/modules out/ed-journal-monitor/bin/src/ && find out -name '__pycache__' -type d -prune -exec rm -rf {} + && cd out && rm -f ../ed-journal-monitor.zip && zip -r ../ed-journal-monitor.zip ed-journal-monitor -x '*/__pycache__/*' '*.pyc' && cd .. && rm -rf out

author: AwaNoodle
